long_biography.plain_text:
Constantinou became director and secretary of E-Cars UK Auto Sales, later joining E-Cars Group and Global Motors. He held controlling interests in the vehicle companies before their ownership moved beneath corporate holding entities, while he remained on their boards. The businesses were organised around new and used vehicle sales, parts and related holdings.

A separate structure followed in 2023, when Constantinou became director and controller of a marine holding company. That business holds a controlling stake in a subsidiary, whose board he also joined. He additionally directs Astir Motors and Conat Enterprises. His corporate roles combine automotive-company governance with control of a distinct marine holding structure.
